coverage.exhaustive_transition_method: Every displayed frame and neighboring transition was visually inspected in the exported 48px and 96px full-sequence sheets, each showing light and dark backgrounds and an explicit return to frame 0.
coverage.playback_method: Normal-speed and quarter-speed GIFs were played in a hidden IAB browser, observed at multiple time-separated phases at exported 48/96 sizes on both backgrounds. Playback was sampled; exhaustive transition coverage comes from the full-sequence sheet inspection.

final_revision_verification.explanation: The eleven non-arrow states were reviewed before the final arrow rebuild. Every reviewed PNG and GIF was SHA256-verified as byte-identical after the final rebuild. The six changed arrow states were then reviewed from newly generated evidence with the final revision in the browser query to bypass cache.

candidate_decision_note: The automatic report raised zero candidates. Every unflagged displayed transition was nevertheless inspected.

findings: No severe unintended whole-body translation, whole-head scale jump, or one-frame anatomy pop was found.
The visible nose/contact feature or operation marker remains visually stable while intended blinking, ear, fur and paw motions animate.
All six enlarged arrow markers remain clear at 48px and at 96px on light and dark backgrounds, with no observed pet overlap or clipping.

remaining_issues.detail: Mild native-pixel fur/chest outline and texture variation remains visible, especially at 96px. It was distinguished from severe positional jitter; no correction is required for this review pass.

limitations: Review covers exported artwork and browser playback at 48px and 96px. It does not establish actual desktop click feel, installed-cursor behavior, or multi-monitor behavior.
32px, 64px and 128px were outside this visual review scope. Native/structural validation is reported separately.
